rationale: tv_iterative-claude-agentic: val_n=214, train_n=0, tv_lambda=0.001, tv_iterations=120, tv_lr=0.01, tv_clip_max=0.05, tv_decay=0.01, tv_optimizer=gd, tv_init=fbp, rationale=tv_iterative iter-1 (search-20260619-01, corrected protocol): feasibility baseline, NO prior iter. Classical TV-regularized iterative recon (non-trainable) on FBP init over ALL 214 L277 val slices with the 321px detector-geometry FOV. Config = solver defaults (tv_lambda=0.001, tv_lr=0.01, tv_clip_max=0.05, tv_decay=0.01, gd, fbp-init), conservative tv_iterations=120 sized to fit the HARD 20-min train+score budget across 214 slices (the val recon batches all 214 slices through the 2304-view Mayo geometry in a single autograd graph PER iteration, no chunking; old run timing at val_n=5 gives ~0.018 s/slice-iter -> ~3.9 s/iter at val_n=214 -> 120 iters ~8-9 min incl 214-slice load+FBP+score, ~2x margin). FAILURE MODE TO AVOID: n_iter too high -> 214-slice val pass blows the 20-min wall / OOM. HYPOTHESIS: TV-iterative is structurally bounded by FBP on this real LDCT data, so iter-1 lands near the LD-FBP baseline (hr ~0 to slightly positive); establish the clean datapoint under the corrected 214-slice/321px-FOV metric.
